type: robustness of the pathway-over-target ranking under a distribution shift
conclusion: pathway remains the better prior under tissue holdout, so the R145 recommendation generalises
not_underpowered: the observed contrast 0.0765 is 2.3 times the minimum detectable effect 0.0331

pathway_does_not_degrade.caveat: different seeds and evaluation pools, so descriptive only

limits: The double holdout shrinks the evaluation set; the minimum detectable effect is reported.
Retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim.
